output.hook: Missed a day? Your streak doesn’t have to die.

scenes.visual: App icon appears, then fades into a calendar with a broken streak highlighted in red.
scenes.voiceover: Missed a day? Your streak doesn’t have to die.

scenes.visual: User taps 'Repair Streak' button; the red mark turns green and the streak continues.
scenes.voiceover: Streakly lets you repair a missed day by doubling up within the week. No guilt. No reset. Just progress.

scenes.visual: Weekly view showing habit completion targets, with checkmarks filling in across the week.
scenes.voiceover: We score habits against weekly targets, not daily chains. Because real life doesn’t fit into perfect streaks.

scenes.visual: Settings screen showing 'On-Device Only' and 'No Account Needed' toggles enabled.
scenes.voiceover: Your data stays private, on your device. No social feed, no leaderboards, no shame.

scenes.visual: App Store review popup showing a 5-star rating with comment: 'Finally, a habit tracker that gets me.'
scenes.voiceover: Join 800+ beta users who’ve stuck with their habits longer — 41% still tracking at day 30.

scenes.visual: App logo with tagline 'Habits that survive real life.' and {APP_URL} below.
scenes.voiceover: Streakly. Habits that survive real life.

output.cta: Download Streakly today and make your next fresh start the one that lasts.
production_notes: Record screen demo of streak repair flow
